sentences.en: Sami found a can of diesel fuel in Layla's room.
sentences.zh: 萨米在莱拉的房间里发现了一罐柴油。

sentences.en: In France, a lot of cars run on diesel.
sentences.zh: 在法国，很多汽车都使用柴油。

sentences.en: Inhaling diesel exhaust is bad for our health.
sentences.zh: 吸入柴油尾气对我们的健康有害。
